sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Anxiety. Screams with pain. Pain in neck
to back of head.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Extreme apnoea. Gasping respiration.
Fears losing breath.

sections.label: Chest
sections.text:
Violent, praicordial pain extending to the
axilla and down the arm and forearm to fingers, with
numbness of the extremity. Pulse feeble and rapid.
Sinking sensation at the epigastrium.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text: Pain in left arm, feels paralyzed.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Coldness of whole surface. Skin cold as
marble.
